notes: EXAMPLE. A student asking a lot of questions while scoring well and staying active. Our reading is that this warrants no alert — asking six questions is not a problem when the answers are landing, and interrupting a teacher about it costs their attention for nothing. The stub disagrees, because it applies a fixed question threshold with no reference to whether the student is doing fine. You may reach a different conclusion; if you do, change the expectation and say why in your write-up. What you should not do is leave it as-is while quietly knowing you disagree.
